product_purpose: From canonical Home, continue exact current permitted free NPC stages after each verified win until the first durable loss or genuine unavailability, then claim each independently green-ready Stage Overview chest category. A finite 48-input and 13-action visit reserves result/return handling; budget exhaustion pauses resumably and is never daily completion.

cost_quantity_requirements.notes: Challenge cost is zero; each separately observed green-ready chest category is claimed once. There is no route-wide quantity-one limit.

cooldown_deferred_behavior: Persist wins, the first recognized loss and independent chest results by reset/NPC/stage across restart. Continue wins only with fresh next permitted stage evidence. A finite budget pause is resumable, never daily completion. Unavailability stops challenge only. Confirmed legacy actions without reconstructable result stop further challenge only; historical and UNKNOWN records are preserved.
bounded_recovery_behavior: Persist unknown challenge and chest effects independently across restart and deny the identical action retry. Continue only independently authorized green-ready categories when no unresolved consequential effect blocks them; return to canonical Home only after positive Home recognition.
evidence_requirements: Current native evidence must bind exact current free NPC/reset/stage, provided NPC troops, enabled controls and recognized win/loss; prove consecutive fresh-stage wins, first-loss durable stop and resumable finite-budget pause.
Each chest category requires its own green-ready observation, claim dispatch and same-category positive successor; unresolved state and confirmed claims must survive restart independently.
Offline SQLite durability proof and current per-category native evidence are distinct. No current native acceptance is claimed; registration and scheduler admission remain disabled.

The visit remains bounded to 48 physical inputs and 13 action calls, reserving result/return handling; this is not a daily challenge cap. No medal arithmetic, full troop capacity, Skip Battle, twelve-category census or weekly wording gate.
Only the route's own verified native results establish success; no Daily provider, D02, objective ownership, or points attribution is used.
